task: Evaluate claim condition extraction and existing-call condition review against the pre-change pipeline
authorization: User requested checking quality improvement; continue existing user-approved cumulative USD200 task budget, no increase/reset.

estimate.basis: Previous matched four-arm 64-answer run cost $1.74897 over 970 requests. Allow larger extraction/audit prompts and feedback, roughly 7M generator input/0.5M output and 64 judgments of <=4K input/1600 output plus bounded failures.
estimate.uncertainty: Token/rate estimate, not invoice settlement; no additional paid compute/storage provisioned.

budget.guard: Every request reserves full conservative bound atomically before dispatch; successful verified receipts settle at 4x usage, errors/unknown retain bounds. Reject dispatch above cumulative cap. No automatic retry or restart.
budget.stop: Stop only these run workers if accounting fails or cap blocks dispatch; preserve saved answers and artifacts. No new paid compute provisioned.

retry_policy: No regenerated saved answers or replaced judgments. At most one unchanged missing-judge retry after diagnosis; exhausted judgments remain missing. No automatic HTTP retries or worker restart.
primary_comparison: Branch new vs Branch pre-change, paired by case averaging two repeats; only cases complete in both arms.
secondary_comparisons: Each other mode new vs its pre-change counterpart
New Branch vs new Flat and Grounded Linear
Condition extraction recall, audit validity and repairs in draft-to-final progression
missing_data_policy: Baseline Branch courtyard repeat1 has exhausted missing judgment; do not retry/replace. Use seven complete cases for Branch before/after plus descriptive all-judged scores and sensitivity if needed.
limitations: Known-case regression: earlier failures informed implementation; not fresh held-out validation.
Changes combine extraction, state propagation and feedback/revision; before/after does not isolate each component.
Only eight independent authored cases; repeat runs are not independent, intervals unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Saved baseline model samples/judgments are reused; decoding variability and provider drift remain possible.
Text-only simulated endpoint latency excludes ASR/TTS; automatic judge flags need spot checking.
